body.title: Implement the independent shutdown watchdog and ready handshake
body.summary: Add packaged Node-built-in-only watchdog child and parent arm/ready helper with test seams. Observe parenthood rather than numeric PID alone, retain synchronous deadline/stage diagnostics and exit after healthy parent termination. Expose explicit spawn/early-exit/ready-timeout failure to the caller; import no graph/vector code. Readiness must include the native broker's validated stable handle. The Node wrapper imports built-ins only and launches the packaged broker; parenthood checks supplement rather than replace kernel-capability safety.
acceptanceChecks: Disposable blocked parent ends at the configured deadline; normally exiting parent leaves no watchdog.
Reparented/reused PID is never signalled and helper imports only Node built-ins.
Ready is acknowledged before arming succeeds; spawn, early exit and timeout failures are observable.
Compiled distribution includes both parent helper and child entrypoint.

tests.name: Independent watchdog bounds a disposable blocked parent and disarms after healthy exit
Ready handshake reports spawn failure, early exit and timeout
Watchdog never signals after reparenting and imports only Node built-ins
